reason: Real gaps, but two particulars are overstated. (1) The ratio nulls are not 'silent': every one (price_to_book, book_value, roe, debt_to_equity, revenue_ttm, net_income_ttm, revenue_growth) already carries field_meta status 'unavailable', reason 'provider did not publish this field', the same labelling as forward_pe, so fix (b)'s 'at minimum' option already exists; what remains is a coverage gap (no derived fallback) against real screener.in values. (2) FII/DII: the 30-Jun-2026 BSE SHP XBRL (re-fetched) has NO Institutions/InstitutionsDomestic/InstitutionsForeign member at all (zero-by-omission), and the app correctly derives and serves institutions_percent 0.0 from public minus non-institutions next to the null split, so the zero-institutions fact is not lost; FII/DII null is a missed derivation (total 0 means both 0), low on its own. (3) Pledge is the solid part: there is no pledge/encumbrance field anywhere in the shareholding model or any lane, while the filing states promoter shares encumbered under pledge: 'No'. That is a product-wide schema gap on a mandated subtle-tier field, and it carries the medium. Aside, not in this finding: the same fundamentals response serves gross/operating/profit_margin = 0.0 with status 'ok' (a straight pass-through of Yahoo's zeros, yfinance_provider.py:383-385) for a company with roughly 55% net margin. That is a wrong value shown as true and should be filed separately.
